question: If $A,B,C$ and $D$ are statements such that if at least one of $A$ and $B$ is true, then at least one of $C$ and $D$ must be true. Further, both $A$ and $C$ are false. Then

options.A: if $D$ is false then $B$ is false
options.B: if $B$ and $D$ are false then $B$ is true
options.D: if $B$ is true then $D$ is true.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
